claims.statement: Carrier Operations confirms that any correction they apply is reversible, scoped to a single carrier feed, and must be applied only after the affected feed and its lag are identified; replaying held allocations is safe only after pickup slots are corrected.
claims.corroboration: tier-1 verified owner_confirmation directly from Carrier Operations, the action owner, sufficient as a single authoritative source for a procedural/scope statement.
claims.limitation: Procedural and scope confirmation only, marked non-discriminating. It does not indicate whether carriers actually received (or failed to receive) pickup manifests for EXC-0921 orders, so it does not resolve the open confound between allocation_rule_defect and carrier_feed_lag for these orders.

next_action.rationale: The confirm_with_carrier_ops result (m8_r_owner) returned only mitigation-scope/procedural information, not data on whether carriers received pickup manifests for EXC-0921 orders, so C4's confound between allocation_rule_defect and carrier_feed_lag/dock_capacity remains open. Tracing the actual allocation-to-carrier handoff for the EXC-0921 cohort will show directly whether split-reservation orders failed to produce a valid handoff record (supporting allocation_rule_defect) versus handoffs completing normally while carriers still failed to collect (supporting carrier_feed_lag or dock_capacity).
next_action.expected_information_gain: Direct, discriminating evidence on where in the allocation-to-pickup chain the EXC-0921 orders stall, isolating a rule/handoff defect from a carrier- or dock-side cause.
